title: Stability of nontrivial graph pairs
summary: A graph pair $(Γ, Σ)$ is called stable if every automorphism of the direct product $Γ\timesΣ$ is induced componentwise by automorphisms of $Γ$ and $Σ$. A graph is twin-free if no two distinct vertices share the same neighbourhood in the graph. Two graphs $Γ$ and $Σ$ are coprime with respect to the direct product if there is no graph $Δ$ of order greater than $1$ such that $Γ\congΓ'\timesΔ$ and $Σ\congΣ'\timesΔ$ for some graphs $Γ'$ and $Σ'$.
